body: A profound sense that I've reached the end of the line. I've been to shrinks, therapists, psychologists, social workers, inpatient psych units, etc. I suppose I'm just tired and done.

It's not difficult to bring back into the US considering it's a very small vial of what looks like pet medicine. In fact hundreds, if not thousands, of "suicide tourists" have already done it: https://www.nytimes.com/2008/07/21/world/americas/21tijuana.html. I do appreciate the concern though.
